what_it_does: French-bookmaker odds scraper with GUI that optimises stakes across books for arbitrage and promo/freebet conversion.
lesson_for_system: Edge comes from comparing many books and exploiting promos, not from re-pricing one soft book against itself.

what_it_does: Live arbitrage detector across FanDuel, DraftKings and William Hill in-play feeds.
lesson_for_system: Live edges are defined cross-book with simultaneous quotes; the system has only one book so cannot observe a true price discrepancy.

what_it_does: Small library for odds conversion, arbitrage detection and value-bet sizing.
lesson_for_system: Value is computed against an external fair price; the system's fair price is derived from the same book it bets into.

what_it_does: Simple arbitrage finder over The Odds API multi-bookmaker data (toy-scale).
lesson_for_system: Even toy scanners pull dozens of books; a single-book feed is the minimum viable input, not a reference price.

what_it_does: Real-time surebet software polling multiple bookmakers.
lesson_for_system: Requires quote timestamps from all legs to be close; the system needs explicit staleness/latency checks on live odds.

what_it_does: Bot that scrapes several bookmakers and alerts on surebets.
lesson_for_system: Alert-and-verify flow before staking; the system auto-bets without a second-source confirmation.

what_it_does: Scanner for arbitrage and edge opportunities across books.
lesson_for_system: Edge threshold is set against the vig and cross-book spread; the system should require edge well above its own model error.

what_it_does: De-vigs a sharp book (Pinnacle) as truth, flags soft books paying more, paper-trades and grades every bet by CLV; author notes ML alone could not beat the close.
lesson_for_system: Use a sharp-book de-vigged price as the fair reference and grade by CLV before risking money; this is the inverse of the system's design.

what_it_does: Scraper identifying positive-EV bets versus a consensus price with historical result logging.
lesson_for_system: Keep a historical ledger of predicted EV versus realised outcome to test whether claimed edge is real.

what_it_does: Compares Pinnacle odds against other sportsbooks to flag +EV bets (toy).
lesson_for_system: Pinnacle-as-anchor is the standard +EV reference; the system lacks any sharp anchor.

what_it_does: Retired Polymarket sports market-making/arb bot that de-vigs sportsbook odds, quotes and hedges; README documents why the 'safe' strategy still bled money.
lesson_for_system: Real-money post-mortems show stale odds and speed dominate; the system must measure fill-time price drift and adverse selection.

what_it_does: Scrapes 1xbet and AsianConnect, stores odds and computes arbitrage profit.
lesson_for_system: Persists raw multi-book odds history so edges can be audited later.

what_it_does: Scrapes live-match odds from broker sites to find in-play surebets.
lesson_for_system: In-play scanning across brokers rather than one book; same lesson on cross-source reference.

what_it_does: Archived surebet scanner and betting bot.
lesson_for_system: Archived bots illustrate that soft books limit winners quickly; the system should track account limits and stake caps.

what_it_does: Polls OddsJam API and compares lines to sharp books to find +EV (toy).
lesson_for_system: Fair line from sharp books, not from a Poisson re-price of the soft book.

what_it_does: Pulls The Odds API data and computes EV against consensus fair odds.
lesson_for_system: Consensus no-vig across many books is a cheap, better fair-price baseline than one book.

what_it_does: betfairlightweight: Betfair Exchange API-NG wrapper with streaming market and order data.
lesson_for_system: Exchange data gives traded volume and back/lay depth, which is a far better live fair price than a soft book quote.

what_it_does: Event-driven betting trading framework with risk controls, simulation, paper trading and multi-venue execution.
lesson_for_system: Separates strategy, risk management, simulation and paper trading; the system auto-bets without a paper-trading gate or exposure controls.

what_it_does: Official Betfair API-NG sample clients in several languages.
lesson_for_system: Official API access with documented order states beats scraping a soft book.

what_it_does: Official Betfair exchange stream API sample for real-time market and order data.
lesson_for_system: Push-stream data with sequence ids lets you detect stale quotes; the system needs quote-age checks.

what_it_does: Betfair data science hub with tutorials on modelling, backtesting and automated strategies.
lesson_for_system: Tutorials stress backtesting against exchange prices and commission; the system ignores market efficiency at the reference price.

what_it_does: R package for Betfair API-NG via JSON-RPC.
lesson_for_system: Mature R clients exist for exchange data; no excuse for single-book pricing.

what_it_does: Older Python wrapper for the Betfair API.
lesson_for_system: Shows a long history of exchange-based tooling the system could reuse.

what_it_does: Node.js Betfair API-NG library.
lesson_for_system: Same: exchange integration is a solved problem across languages.

what_it_does: Python wrapper for the Pinnacle Sports API.
lesson_for_system: Pinnacle odds are the industry fair-price benchmark; the system should pull them as reference.

what_it_does: R wrapper for the Pinnacle API maintained by a Pinnacle analyst.
lesson_for_system: Sharp-book feeds are accessible from R as well as Python.

what_it_does: Lightweight client for the PS3838 (Pinnacle asian) API including bet placement.
lesson_for_system: Sharp-book access is still available via PS3838 for regions where Pinnacle is closed.

what_it_does: Official Pinnacle API documentation.
lesson_for_system: Documents line ids, max-stake and line-change semantics the system should mirror in its order logic.

what_it_does: Python wrapper for the Betdaq exchange API.
lesson_for_system: Second exchange source to cross-check fair prices.

what_it_does: Python wrapper for the Matchbook exchange API.
lesson_for_system: Third exchange source; multi-venue reference prices.

what_it_does: Archived official Smarkets Python SDK.
lesson_for_system: Exchanges publish SDKs; archived status means prefer betfairlightweight/flumine.

what_it_does: BetConnect API client from the betcode-org ecosystem.
lesson_for_system: Mature ecosystems wrap several venues behind one execution layer.

what_it_does: DuckDB ledger that logs open, bet and close prices and grades no-vig CLV separately from win-loss (toy).
lesson_for_system: Record open/bet/close for every order and report no-vig CLV as the primary process metric; win-loss alone is noise.

what_it_does: NFL line tracking with CLV calculation and performance analysis (toy).
lesson_for_system: Line-movement tracking after the bet tells you whether the model is ahead of or behind the market.

what_it_does: Fast Python parser for Betfair historical data files.
lesson_for_system: Historical exchange tick data enables honest in-play backtests with realistic prices.

what_it_does: Turns Betfair historical data into a queryable SQL database.
lesson_for_system: Store historical reference prices in SQL for joins against own orders.

what_it_does: Official workbook for downloading and interpreting Betfair historical data.
lesson_for_system: Official historical in-play data exists to calibrate live models against market prices.

what_it_does: Community repo of Betfair automated/AI trading strategies and tools.
lesson_for_system: Community strategies run on exchange liquidity with explicit commission accounting.

what_it_does: Fast Kelly staking for back and lay bets with any number of outcomes and existing positions; simultaneous bets on the roadmap.
lesson_for_system: Kelly must account for existing positions on the same match and mutually exclusive outcomes; the system sizes each bet in isolation.

what_it_does: Kelly criterion calculation for asset allocation.
lesson_for_system: Kelly assumes known probabilities; with estimated edge it overbets, so fractional Kelly must be tied to edge uncertainty.

what_it_does: Simulates multi-armed bandits combined with Kelly for portfolio allocation.
lesson_for_system: Treats edge as uncertain and learned online; the system takes model edge at face value.

what_it_does: Code for a working paper on drawdown-constrained Kelly with Bayesian shrinkage of the edge estimate (research toy).
lesson_for_system: Shrink Kelly fraction by estimation uncertainty and scale it by distance to a drawdown barrier.

what_it_does: Small package for Kelly and EV bet sizing (toy).
lesson_for_system: Basic Kelly calculators are common; sizing is not where the edge comes from.

what_it_does: Portfolio optimisation library with many risk measures including drawdown and Kelly-type objectives.
lesson_for_system: Correlated simultaneous bets should be sized jointly with drawdown/CVaR constraints, not one by one.

what_it_does: Portfolio optimisation (efficient frontier, Black-Litterman, HRP) in Python.
lesson_for_system: Covariance-aware allocation and shrinkage of expected returns apply to a book of concurrent bets.

what_it_does: Shin's method for implied probabilities from bookmaker odds with convergence diagnostics.
lesson_for_system: If de-vigging, use Shin or power with convergence checks rather than proportional normalisation; it corrects favourite-longshot bias.

what_it_does: Development repo of the CRAN implied package: basic, Shin, power, additive, odds-ratio, WPO and other de-vig methods.
lesson_for_system: Compare several de-vig methods on your own data; method choice alone can create or remove apparent edge.

what_it_does: Odds-to-probability conversion that adjusts for favourite-longshot bias, used in many Kaggle medal solutions.
lesson_for_system: Margin is not spread evenly; long prices carry more vig, so naive de-vig overstates longshot edge.

what_it_does: Multiplicative, additive, power and Shin de-vig via stable bisection (toy).
lesson_for_system: Simple multi-method de-vig references exist for unit tests.

what_it_does: Football analytics package with Poisson, Dixon-Coles, bivariate and other goal models, ratings, scrapers and implied-odds/de-vig utilities.
lesson_for_system: Use Dixon-Coles-type models with time decay and validate them against market odds instead of a plain Poisson re-price.

what_it_does: Dataloaders plus bettor classes that backtest betting strategies with time-series cross-validation, CLI and GUI.
lesson_for_system: Backtest with walk-forward splits and odds from a named source before going live.

what_it_does: AutoML framework for trading systems and sports betting with feature pipelines and backtests.
lesson_for_system: Pipelines separate train/test by time and report out-of-sample performance.

what_it_does: net:cal calibration library with ECE metrics, reliability diagrams and calibration methods.
lesson_for_system: Measure reliability of model probabilities by bucket; miscalibrated probabilities turn into fake edge.

what_it_does: Calibration library from the NeurIPS paper Verified Uncertainty Calibration with debiased ECE.
lesson_for_system: Use debiased calibration error with confidence intervals on small samples.

what_it_does: Archived library of proper scoring rules (CRPS, Brier).
lesson_for_system: Score probabilities with proper scores against market baselines, not ROI alone.

what_it_does: R package for Poisson, Dixon-Coles, negative binomial and other football goal models.
lesson_for_system: Goal models need dependence and overdispersion terms; plain independent Poisson misprices draws and low totals.

what_it_does: R package for soccer modelling including Dixon-Coles.
lesson_for_system: Reference implementation for testing the system's Poisson re-pricing.

what_it_does: Popular NBA ML betting project that outputs expected value and Kelly stake suggestions; README shows no CLV grading.
lesson_for_system: Popularity does not equal proven edge; check if a project grades against closing lines.

what_it_does: Scrapes historical and upcoming odds from OddsPortal for many bookmakers and markets.
lesson_for_system: Multi-bookmaker historical odds are freely scrapeable for backtesting and consensus prices.

what_it_does: OddsPortal odds and results scraper.
lesson_for_system: Same; get closing odds from many books for CLV.

what_it_does: Soccer odds scraper for several bookmakers.
lesson_for_system: Lightweight multi-book odds source.

what_it_does: Scrapes Club Elo, ESPN, FBref, Football-Data.co.uk, Sofascore, Understat, WhoScored and more.
lesson_for_system: Football-Data.co.uk via soccerdata provides Pinnacle closing odds history for free CLV checks.

what_it_does: Python package for scraping soccer data from multiple sources.
lesson_for_system: Additional feature sources for live state such as xG.

what_it_does: Fetches live football stats from Sofascore, FBref, Promiedos and others.
lesson_for_system: Live state (cards, xG, shots) should feed the in-play model beyond scoreline and clock.

what_it_does: Scrapes match results and statistics from Flashscore.
lesson_for_system: Independent live-score source to cross-check event timing and avoid betting on stale state.

what_it_does: OpenAPI spec and SDKs for a multi-book odds API with arbitrage and +EV examples.
lesson_for_system: Commercial multi-book feeds are cheap compared to losses from single-book pricing.

what_it_does: Official Python samples for The Odds API covering many bookmakers including sharp books.
lesson_for_system: Low-cost way to add Pinnacle and consensus prices as reference.

what_it_does: R package to scrape live betting odds.
lesson_for_system: Older but shows live multi-book scraping is long established.

what_it_does: Python package for sports data from ESPN and other sources.
lesson_for_system: Free live-score data for state verification.

what_it_does: Self-hosted SofaScore data platform across 21 sports.
lesson_for_system: Persist live event streams to align with order timestamps.
